title: Identity
summary: Identity states that two references pick out the same object within a declared framework.

content.plain: Identity states that two references pick out the same object within a declared framework.
content.exact: Equality is represented by a binary predicate = satisfying at least reflexivity and substitution of identicals in the chosen logic.
content.example: If a=b, replacing a by b in an equality-respecting expression preserves its denotation.
content.caveat: Definitional equality, propositional equality, isomorphism, and observational equivalence must not be silently conflated.
